points.description: States that the top of the stack is kept toward the end of the array (the right side / highest used index), not the front.
points.partial_credit: Half if it says the end/right side of the array is used but does not explicitly identify it as the top of the stack.

points.description: States that push adds an element and pop removes an element at that end, i.e. the right side of the array, so both operations act at the same end.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of push or pop is correctly tied to the right/end side.

points.description: Gives the correct distinction: operations happen at the end (right side), not at the beginning (left side) of the array, so no elements need to be shifted.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the top of the stack placed at the end (right side) of the array, with push and pop both explicitly adding/removing at that end. Part marks only where clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely. Vague answers (e.g. "use an array with push and pop"), or putting the top at the front/left, earn nothing for that point.
